notes.title: A bit more patch
notes.content:
-Added 3 more Achievements to the game

-Adjusted the Hermit's movement functions

-Fixed a bug caused by one of the recent updates where the Gooper Spawners had lost their hitbox and failed the collide with anything which made a bunch of the puzzles in the Blood Temple easier.  
Now those spawners are back to normal again.

notes.title: Hazard Block Patch
notes.content:
-Changed the way hazard blocks interact and function when the Hermit slashes them

-Changed the Alien Console Access requirements to be more balanced

notes.title: Grimy Sewer Patch
notes.content: -Just made some changes to all of the Grimy Sewer Puzzles

notes.title: Tweak Patch
notes.content:
-Moved the selected ability cartridge icon from the right side of the screen, to the left side of the screen, underneath the player's health 

-Lengthened the Hermit's talking bubble

-Adjusted a specific puzzle in the Grimy Sewers where a player could potentially get stuck.

notes.title: Adjustment Patch
notes.content:
-Changed some SFX during the opening of the Game and added a screen shake when the menu book slams open

Fixed Bugs caused by recent enhancement update:
-Fixed Bug in the Hermit's basement where the Hermit could not re-enter the basement after collecting the Key and leaving.
-Fixed a bug in the Grimy Sewers where a gate half way through would not unlock when prompted to be unlocked

notes.title: 1.6.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
-Made it easier to acquire abilities
-adjusted some text 
-adjusted some logic when interacting with consoles

notes.title: EXP Retrieval Update
notes.content:
Game Version 1.6 of the Knowledge of Hermit includes:

-The ability for the player to go back to the room where the player died and got a game over to be able to retrieve and double the EXP they lost on death. 

-Also fixed an audio bug that occurred when the player continued their game from the title screen where the title screen music continued to play during gameplay until the player paused the game or made it to the next area.

-Added a New achievement for when the player retrieves their lost EXP from dying and getting a game over.

notes.title: Hermit Enhancement Update
notes.content:
The Knowledge of Hermit Game Version 1.5.5.0 includes:

-Many updated and replaced sprites
-Removed some harsh sounding SFX and replaced them with brand new SFX
-Made some changes to all of the Frozen Tower Puzzles
-gameplay optimizations
-New updated backgrounds
-Refined gameplay mechanics
-Hint Bubbles
-The game now autosaves more when entering a room
-Bug fixes
-crash repairs


*This update is only available for the Windows Operating System

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.content:
Added a basic Tutorial for new players as well as additional sprites, prompts, and a new Menu Background.

+Improved Damage Delay
+Lessened Damage Force
+Fixed Wall Clipping
+Hidden Additions
